          Why Fly to Africa

          Discover incredible landscapes, vibrant cultures, and thrilling wildlife adventures across Africa. Fly in complete comfort and experience warm hospitality as you connect to magnificent destinations. Experience breathtaking safaris, explore bustling local markets, and relax along pristine tropical coastlines. Whether you seek exhilarating outdoor journeys or inspiring cultural encounters, Africa offers unforgettable possibilities for every traveler. Book your flight today and embark on an extraordinary journey.

          Explore Popular Flight Destinations in Africa

          01

          Uncover History in Cairo

          Walk through ancient marvels and vibrant bazaars along the famous Nile River. Experience lively traditional markets, discover fascinating museum artifacts, and enjoy scenic riverfront dining in Egypt's energetic heart.

          02

          Relax in Sharm El Sheikh

          Dive into crystal-clear waters along the Red Sea coast. Discover colorful coral reefs, enjoy thrilling water sports, and unwind on sun-soaked sandy beaches ideal for total relaxation.

          03

          Experience Coastal Charm in Casablanca

          Stroll through vibrant coastal promenades and marvel at striking architectural landmarks. Explore bustling local markets, sample delicious North African cuisine, and enjoy stunning Atlantic Ocean views.

          04

          Discover Adventure in Nairobi

          Embark on exhilarating safari journeys through sprawling nature reserves. Spot incredible local wildlife, immerse yourself in rich cultural traditions, and experience breathtaking natural landscapes.

          05

          Unwind in Tropical Mauritius

          Relax on pristine white-sand shores surrounded by turquoise lagoons. Experience scenic mountain hikes, peaceful botanical gardens, and world-class resort hospitality in an island paradise.

          FAQs

          Traveling to Africa

          Make planning your Africa trip as enjoyable as the vacation itself. Read our answers to common questions and prepare for the perfect island escape.

          How far in advance should I book my flight to Africa?

          The best time to book a flight to Africa is 3 - 6 months before your date of travel. This would give you the best chance of finding the best prices and timings that fit your schedule.

          Can I change or cancel my flight to Africa?

          Yes, we offer free cancellation on flights to Africa subject to our cancellation and refund policy. Read our cancellation and refund policy for more information.

          Can I get extra baggage allowance for flights to Africa?

          If our standard baggage allowance is not enough, you can add extra baggage to your flight booking at an additional fee. Read more about our additional baggage charges .
